data: Tesla reported GAAP diluted EPS of $2.04 for fiscal 2024, down from $4.30 in fiscal 2023, a decline of about 52.6%. The 2024 figure is based on net income attributable to common stockholders of roughly $7.09 billion (GAAP), compared with about $14.97 billion in fiscal 2023. Note that the 2023 diluted EPS of $4.30 reflects a one-time non-cash tax benefit of about $5.0 billion from releasing a valuation allowance on deferred tax assets, which inflated that year's comparison. On a non-GAAP basis, diluted EPS was $2.27 in 2024 versus $3.12 in 2023, a drop of about 27%. These figures are from memory of Tesla's 10-K filings, so please verify them against the filings before relying on them.
